notes.title: The demo version of “Moji Yuugi” is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Kou from Flyhigh Works.
We have released a demo version of “Moji Yuugi(Japanese version)” at Steam Next Fest!

The game content is almost the same as “Moji Yuugi Chapter Zero”,
but we have made some changes to the text and the message after the ending.

Regarding the release of the main version of “Moji Yuugi”,
we have overcome various difficulties and are currently in the final stages of checking.
We know we've kept you waiting a long time, but
we're confident that you'll be surprised by the final product.

Starting with the release of this demo version,
we plan to regularly send out various information about the game,
so please add it to your wishlist
and, if you can, we'd be happy to receive your support comments and feedback on the demo version.

Thank you for your continued support.

Flyhigh Works
Kou

notes.title: Japanese Trailer is released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
We have released an Trailer of Mojiyuugi(Japanese version).

The scenes include some under development, though,

The video shows how "I" challenge various difficulties in a world composed only of letters.

The work on the Japanese-language version will take more time,
We hope you will continue to support us.
